CherryStudio

Your Unified AI Assistant Platform

Version 1.7.15 | Community & Enterprise Editions

Product Overview

CherryStudio is a powerful desktop AI assistant application built with Electron that provides a unified interface for interacting with multiple large language model providers across Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms.

🤖

Multi-Provider

📄

Document AI

🧠

Knowledge Base

⚡

Core Features

Multi-Provider LLM Support

  • OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Azure, DeepSeek, Mistral, and more
  • Local models with Ollama and LM Studio
  • Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints

Advanced Document Processing

  • Support for PDF, Word, Excel, Images, EPUB, CSV, XML
  • Markdown rendering with KaTeX math and Mermaid charts
  • OCR capabilities for image text extraction

Knowledge Base with RAG

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation for accurate responses
  • WebDAV integration for file management and backup
  • Custom knowledge bases for specialized domains

Technical Architecture

Main Process

  • Node.js Backend
  • MCP Service
  • Knowledge Service
  • Agent System

Renderer Process

  • React 19.2.0 UI
  • Redux Toolkit
  • TypeScript
  • Dexie Database

Core Services

  • AI Core Middleware
  • IPC Bridge
  • Storage Service
  • Window Manager

Built with Modern Technologies

Electron 38.7.0 | React 19 | TypeScript | Redux | pnpm

Use Cases

Enterprise Teams

Centralized model management, access control, and knowledge base sharing for collaborative AI workflows.

✍️

Content Creators

Writing assistance, translation, content optimization across multiple language models.
